verdict.rationale: Jules is explicitly a cloud-hosted agent service: tasks run in Google-managed VMs, integrated with GitHub, with an API and usage limits/plans, requiring no self-hosted backend. Community evidence corroborates real-world usage at scale (75% success on customer PRs, teams dispatching many tasks) though some users report reliability/UI issues. Missing for 10: no independent infra/SLA details, no discoverable OpenAPI/docs.md confirming API completeness, and mixed community reliability reports.
